sections.title: What this version covers
sections.html:
This preview covers P0 Runtime preparation, Doctor, and the first transcription path. Real GPU validation has passed. The preview runs no checks and submits no music Jobs.

The FastAPI core is being delivered in P1. The product Web Workbench starts in P2. Product tutorials will follow implemented stages.

View current scope and later stages →

sections.title: Your first result
sections.html:
The transcription tool retains the input, request, and history. It validates the complete ABC, then exports and reads MIDI. A successful receipt contains status=completed and verified=true.

A file or HTTP 200 alone cannot prove success. A fixed short sample does not establish transcription accuracy for arbitrary music.

zh.title: 准备本地 Runtime
zh.summary: 在仓库根目录执行。准备完成后，你会得到 Runtime READY，再进入启动与转谱。

sections.title: 开始前
sections.html:
• Windows x64，RTX 3070 Ti Laptop，标称 8 GiB VRAM。
  • 已安装 Git、uv 与可用的 NVIDIA 驱动。
  • 模型下载约 9.19 GB；Doctor 另要求 10 GiB 工作余量。
  • 使用独立的 Python 3.12.13 Runtime 环境。
只在自己的就绪环境执行

这些命令会准备代码、下载依赖与模型。真实 GPU 请求须由当前 resource owner 串行运行。

sections.title: 1. 准备锁定环境
sections.html: 命令克隆锁定的 Runtime 与自定义节点，并安装锁文件中的依赖。已有 checkout 必须匹配锁定提交，且没有 tracked 修改。

sections.title: 2. 准备模型
sections.html: 权重保存到 data/models/。YuE2 与 SheetSage2 权重采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0；代码许可独立记录。
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py download-models

sections.title: 3. 得到就绪结果
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py doctor
sections.after:
成功输出 Runtime READY，退出码为 0。失败输出 Runtime NOT READY，退出码为 1，并给出逐项恢复动作。

如果模型下载中断，重新执行 download-models 续传。.part 文件不算就绪。

sections.title: 下一步
sections.html:
阅读 Doctor 的检查边界，再保存启动前 receipt、启动本地服务并执行转谱。

检查并启动 Runtime →

en.title: Prepare the local Runtime
en.summary: Run from the repository root. Get Runtime READY, then continue to launch and transcription.

sections.title: Before you start
sections.html:
• Windows x64, RTX 3070 Ti Laptop, nominal 8 GiB VRAM.
  • Git, uv, and a working NVIDIA driver are installed.
  • About 9.19 GB of model downloads. Doctor also requires 10 GiB working space.
  • An independent Python 3.12.13 Runtime environment.
Run only in your prepared environment

These commands prepare source and download dependencies and models. The current resource owner must serialize real GPU requests.

sections.title: 1. Prepare the pinned environment
sections.html: This command clones the pinned Runtime and custom nodes, then installs locked dependencies. Existing checkouts must match the pinned commits and have no tracked edits.

sections.title: 2. Prepare the models
sections.html: Weights are saved in data/models/. YuE2 and SheetSage2 weights use CC-BY-NC-4.0. Code licenses are recorded separately.
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py download-models

sections.title: 3. Get the readiness result
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py doctor
sections.after:
Success prints Runtime READY and exits 0. Failure prints Runtime NOT READY, exits 1, and gives recovery actions for each check.

If a model download was interrupted, rerun download-models to resume it. A .part file is not ready.

sections.title: Next step
sections.html:
Read Doctor's limits. Then save the pre-start receipt, launch the local service, and transcribe.

Check and launch Runtime →

zh.title: 检查并启动 Runtime
zh.summary: 准备完成后，保存启动前检查结果，再启动仅监听本机的 Runtime。Doctor 就绪与完整 P0 验收是不同的事实。

sections.title: 保存启动前检查
sections.html: 在仓库根目录执行。只有 Doctor 退出 0 后才启动服务。--no-sync 保证检查不触发依赖下载或环境修改。
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py doctor --json | Out-File -Encoding utf8 data/runtime-readiness.json

sections.title: 启动本地服务
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py start
sections.after:
服务仅监听 http://127.0.0.1:8188，不会自动打开 Canvas。保持此终端运行；用 Ctrl+C 停止。

Doctor 检查空闲端口。服务启动后，转谱工具复用保存的真实成功 receipt，不在占用端口上重新制造就绪结果。

sections.title: 检查边界
sections.html:
Doctor 检查真实 BF16 CUDA 运算、目标设备、锁定版本、节点与推理 imports、重采样、完整模型 SHA256、磁盘和端口。

READY 只表示推理前提就绪

Doctor 不加载完整权重，也不证明音乐质量。其 p0_passed=false 不由一次 readiness 检查改写。

sections.title: 遇到失败时

head: 检查结果
恢复动作
rows: 执行 download-models；保留的 .part 会续传。
保留或移走损坏文件，再重新下载；命令不自动覆盖 invalid 文件。
确认占用者。停止自己的服务，或为 Doctor 与 start 选择同一个空闲 --port。
读取 last_stage、stdout_tail、stderr_tail，解决对应阶段后重试。

sections.after: 返回环境准备，或在成功启动后执行第一次转谱。

en.title: Check and launch Runtime
en.summary: After preparation, save the pre-start check and launch a localhost-only Runtime. Doctor readiness and full P0 acceptance are different facts.

sections.title: Save the pre-start check
sections.html: Run from the repository root. Start only after Doctor exits 0. --no-sync prevents the check from downloading dependencies or changing the environment.
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py doctor --json | Out-File -Encoding utf8 data/runtime-readiness.json

sections.title: Launch the local service
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/manage.py start
sections.after:
The service listens only at http://127.0.0.1:8188 and does not open Canvas. Keep this terminal running. Press Ctrl+C to stop it.

Doctor checks a free port. After launch, the transcription tool reuses the saved real successful receipt. Do not fabricate readiness on an occupied port.

sections.title: What the check covers
sections.html:
Doctor checks actual BF16 CUDA work, the target device, pinned versions, node and inference imports, resampling, full model SHA256, disk, and port.

READY means inference prerequisites are available

Doctor does not load all weights or establish music quality. One readiness check does not change its p0_passed=false.

sections.title: Recover from failure

head: Result
Recovery action
rows: Preserve or move the corrupt file, then download again. The command does not overwrite invalid files.
Identify its owner. Stop your own service, or use the same free --port for Doctor and start.
Read last_stage, stdout_tail, and stderr_tail. Resolve that stage, then retry.

sections.after: Return to preparation, or after a successful launch run the first transcription.

zh.title: 转谱并导出 ABC 与 MIDI
zh.summary: 把原创短音乐送入 SheetSage2。通过 Runtime API 得到可解析的 ABC 与可读取的 MIDI，全程不需要 ComfyUI Canvas。

sections.title: 开始前
sections.html: 先保存 Doctor receipt 并启动 Runtime。在仓库根目录的第二个终端执行以下命令。由当前 GPU resource owner 运行，且 Runtime 队列须为空。

sections.title: 运行第一次转谱
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/p0/transcribe.py --readiness-report data/runtime-readiness.json --output-dir data/p0/transcription/run-01
sections.after:
输出目录必须是新目录或空目录。工具默认生成 16 秒、48 kHz、双声道、16-bit PCM 原创器乐 WAV，输入采用 CC0-1.0。

该命令会上传音频、提交 GPU 推理并保存文件。这里的复制按钮只复制命令，不执行它。

sections.title: 检查你的结果
sections.html: 成功退出 0。打开输出目录，核对 receipt.json 中的 status=completed 与 verified=true。

head: 文件
用途
rows: 默认固定输入与内容 hash。
实际提交请求与完整 Runtime 结果。
通过完整解析、MIDI 导出与非空音符读取的产物。
输入输出 hash、版本、设置与解析证据。

sections.after: 工具先解析完整 ABC，再导出 MIDI、重新上传并读取实际音符。HTTP 200 或文件存在本身不足以成功。

sections.title: 一次失败恢复
sections.html:
如果命令因输出目录非空退出 2，保留已有结果，选择新的输出目录。不要删除旧证据来重复提交。

如果超过默认 1800 秒 timeout，请求可能仍在运行。先核对保存的请求、history 和 queue，由 owner 决定等待或取消。

sections.title: 能力与限制
sections.html:
固定短器乐样本验证流程与文件有效性，不能证明人声或任意音乐的转谱准确率。SheetSage2 权重采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0，与输入的 CC0 许可分开记录。

重复相同音频可能命中插件独立缓存。仅有 public history 不能证明本次进行了新的 GPU 推理；首次执行日志与 GPU 事实由 owner 保留。

此工具验证一次 Runtime 路径，p0_passed 保持 false。完整 P0 验收还包含生成、队列、取消、连续任务和清理。

en.title: Transcribe and export ABC and MIDI
en.summary: Submit original short music to SheetSage2. Get parseable ABC and readable MIDI through Runtime APIs, without opening ComfyUI Canvas.

sections.title: Before you start
sections.html: First save the Doctor receipt and launch Runtime. Run from a second terminal at the repository root. The current GPU resource owner must run this command with an empty Runtime queue.

sections.title: Run the first transcription
commands: uv run --project runtime/comfyui --no-sync python runtime/comfyui/p0/transcribe.py --readiness-report data/runtime-readiness.json --output-dir data/p0/transcription/run-01
sections.after:
The output directory must be new or empty. By default, the tool generates original 16-second, 48 kHz, stereo, 16-bit PCM instrumental audio. The input uses CC0-1.0.

This command uploads audio, submits GPU inference, and writes files. The preview's copy button only copies the command. It does not run it.

sections.title: Check your result
sections.html: Success exits 0. Open the output directory and check status=completed and verified=true in receipt.json.

head: File
Purpose
rows: Default fixed input and content hash.
Submitted request and complete Runtime result.
Artifacts validated by complete parsing, MIDI export, and nonempty note readback.
Input/output hashes, revisions, settings, and parser evidence.

sections.after: The tool parses complete ABC, exports MIDI, uploads it again, and reads its notes. HTTP 200 or a file alone cannot mean success.

sections.title: Recover from one failure
sections.html:
If the command exits 2 because the output directory is not empty, retain the existing results and choose a new directory. Do not delete old evidence to resubmit.

If the default 1800-second timeout expires, the request may still be running. Check its saved request, history, and queue first. The owner decides whether to wait or cancel.

sections.title: Capabilities and limits
sections.html:
The fixed short instrumental sample validates the pipeline and file validity. It does not establish accuracy for vocals or arbitrary music. SheetSage2 weights use CC-BY-NC-4.0, recorded separately from the input's CC0 license.

Repeating identical audio can hit the plugin's independent cache. Public history alone cannot prove fresh GPU inference. The owner retains first-execution logs and GPU facts.

This tool verifies one Runtime path and keeps p0_passed=false. Full P0 acceptance also covers generation, queueing, cancellation, continuous Jobs, and cleanup.

zh.title: 理解应用与 Runtime 的边界
zh.summary: FastAPI 拥有业务对象，ComfyUI 负责推理。Runtime 教程的直接调用用于环境验证；产品客户端通过 FastAPI 工作。

sections.title: 一条明确的调用路径
sections.html: 产品 Web 只连接 FastAPI。Runtime Adapter 把原生执行事件转换为应用 Job 状态。客户端不依赖 ComfyUI node id 或 prompt id。

head: 对象
含义
rows: 围绕歌曲、改编或音乐实验组织创作。
可独立引用的实际文件。
可检查、可编辑的音乐表示。
一次可跟踪状态的转谱或生成请求。
可试听和检查，但尚未保存的候选结果。
创作者明确保存的一次有意义的创作变化。

sections.title: 保存结果的责任
sections.html:
Runtime 输出先经过校验与导入，再成为应用拥有的 Asset。Candidate 只有在创作者明确保存后才成为 Version。

FastAPI 和 ComfyUI 使用独立的 uv 项目、环境与锁文件。普通 API 与文档构建不需要加载 GPU 模型。

sections.title: 回到实践
sections.html: 要得到第一个实际结果，从环境准备进入；已有 Runtime 时查看转谱指南。

en.title: Understand the application and Runtime boundary
en.summary: FastAPI owns domain objects. ComfyUI runs inference. Direct calls in Runtime tutorials validate the environment. Product clients work through FastAPI.

sections.title: One explicit request path
sections.html: The product Web app connects only to FastAPI. The Runtime Adapter translates native execution events into application Job states. Clients do not depend on ComfyUI node or prompt ids.

head: Object
Meaning
rows: Organizes a song, cover, or music experiment.
An actual file that can be referenced independently.
A music representation that can be inspected and edited.
One trackable transcription or generation request.
A result that can be heard and inspected, but is not saved yet.
A meaningful creative change explicitly saved by its creator.

sections.title: Who owns saved results
sections.html:
Runtime output is validated and imported before it becomes an application-owned Asset. A Candidate becomes a Version only when the creator explicitly saves it.

FastAPI and ComfyUI use independent uv projects, environments, and locks. Normal API and documentation builds do not load GPU models.

sections.title: Return to practice
sections.html: For your first real result, start with environment preparation. If Runtime is ready, open the transcription guide.

sections.title: Current documentation entrypoints
